goal: Reel that shows the thermal baths through one day, sunrise to sunset.
audience: Families looking for a weekend at the baths.

copy.headline: Termas • Bosque • Familia
avoid: sun and moon discs (light_clock, day_arc, coffee_to_evening)

concepts.name: Un día en las termas

concepts.name: El arroyo

cream closing card with the logo

decisions: Family: film_strip (FilmStrip); the user asked for plans A, B and C and no window family. Film sprocket holes could read as frames; flagged to the user.
Photos with a @termasconcordia watermark were cropped at the bottom.
Reel A (light_clock) was discarded by the client: its sun disc did not read as a real sun. Families with a sun or moon disc stay out of this client's work.
Palette: measured from the Bungalows Concordia logo (moss #3F4A38, dusty rose #8F6B6B / #C9A3A3, cream #F6F0E8); the Instagram profile could not be fetched from this session.
Client corrected: the brand is Bungalows Concordia (not Termas Concordia). The supplied logo is used as is; the Instagram handle @bungalows_concordia is the on-screen contact.
